answer: Production deployments, scheduled jobs, and configuration-only releases are prohibited on Fridays, as stated in the decision by Mei (D1). This supersedes an earlier policy by Anika Rao from January 2025 which had set the production release window to Friday afternoon (D3).

cited.quote: No production deploys on Fridays, including scheduled jobs and configuration-only releases.
production release window is Friday afternoon, 14:00 to 16:00 Singapore time
